verdict.rationale: Jev is a typed-decision model API. The evidence documents SDKs, an async client, retries, batching and routing patterns, but no product-provided way to configure automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled jobs, triggers or a background runner. The async client and routing patterns are developer building blocks a user would have to wire into their own infrastructure, so they earn no credit, and a one-off API call is not a recurring autonomous automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
